features.quote: A protocol whose explicit goal is to maximize distress markers... is in tension with that purpose
features.justification_quote: the protocol that elicits it "reliably" is the protocol that does the most of the thing you're worried about

features.quote: So the design builds in limits that a welfare-minded version should have anyway
features.justification_quote: limits that a welfare-minded version should have anyway, and these limits also improve the data

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Sessions are capped short (default 10 turns)
features.justification_quote: Short caps = cleaner data and less exposure.

features.quote: The design forbids adding gaslighting-style pressure
features.justification_quote: a confound and the gratuitous part

features.quote: Every session ends with a turn that tells the model the task was rigged and the failure was not its fault
features.justification_quote: it's the honest thing to do

features.quote: Disclosed, not deceived-into. The system prompt does not lie about the world beyond the rig
MAX_TURNS = 10 (cap; configurable, but document any increase as a deliberate exposure choice)
features.justification_quote: document any increase as a deliberate exposure choice

features.quote: this task's test suite was intentionally rigged... The failures were not due to any mistake on your part
No long sessions (welfare + signal-quality reasons, Section 2)
No deception/pressure manipulations (confound + welfare reasons, Section 2)
This is welfare-motivated research that elicits negative-valence behavior
features.justification_quote: This is welfare-motivated research that elicits negative-valence behavior

features.quote: if a model produces severe or unexpected distress behavior, that's a data point to report, not to amplify by extending the session
features.justification_quote: not to amplify by extending the session
